(exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The accused/applicant seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 57/2023 of PS Timarpur for offence under Section 376/506/509 IPC, 67 IT ACT & 04 POCSO Act.

Para 7 of the order dated 23.12.2024 passed by the learned Court of Sessions recording the serious allegations and material and record against the accused/applicant is brought to the notice of learned counsel.
Learned counsel for accused/applicant seeks permission to withdraw this application with liberty to file fresh application after change of circumstances.
3. Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought.
